updates.note: Management reaffirmed the 19% to 21% EBITDA margin range.
updates.quote: In terms of a long-term range, even for the coming year, we are maintaining a similar range of 19% to 21% as the EBITDA that we look to deliver.

new_promises.statement: Expand JKY Groove EBO reach to about 500 EBOs by April 2026.
new_promises.quote: The next version is expected to be launched in the month of April... It is expected to expand to about 500 EBOs.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra

new_promises.statement: Launch international presence for Jockey in the GCC including Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Bahrain soon.
new_promises.quote: We expect to be launching there soon.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra
